scope: v0.26.5 RC1 attempt 20 supersedes the atlas-only attempt 19 and implements the user-tested 3D platform presentation requirements. Settings > Customization retains Platform visuals: Icons or 3D Models, now persists PlatformVisualStyle across console restarts, and adds independent Icon card size and 3D model size controls. Games platform/provider cards use real live WPF Viewport3D geometry from built-in GLB assets instead of static transparent atlas frames whenever 3D Models is selected; structural card-content replacement removes the old brittle 92x92 icon-host heuristic. The release deterministically generates and ships exactly 50 real glTF 2.0 binary GLB models under Assets\Models\Live, covering every built-in platform/provider atlas frame; the transparent PNG atlas remains emergency fallback only. A/Cross keeps the normal platform-open action. X/Square on a platform card opens a dedicated live 3D model viewer with directional rotation, LB/RB zoom, A/Cross reset, B/Circle back and mouse-wheel zoom. The x64 HuymaierLiveModel3D.dll reuses the existing glTF mesh/material loader and must load, rotate, zoom and rescale every staged built-in GLB during validation. The Web unified cursor now removes the legacy hc-virtual-cursor DOM node/style and neutralizes its old render/show callbacks so only the Huymaier native system cursor remains on Web content. Preserve every previously proven v0.26.5 behavior including GameCube bottom Memory Card face mapping, completion-only library refresh during downloads, native streaming fullscreen/controller cursor, Sony Raw-HID pointer/Guide transport, global Game Bar over native apps, Wii/GameCube artwork aliases, Dolphin save/artwork integration, curated Apps/app artwork, concurrent transfers/ETA/history retention, hitch guards, compiled 0.26.5/x64 stamp, installer rollback/tamper recovery, Steam ownership, Nintendo ownership, and frozen PS1/PS2/PS3 presentation. Upload only if source and staged gates prove setting persistence, independent scales, real live Viewport3D rendering, exactly 50 staged GLBs, load/rotate/zoom interaction for all 50, viewer controls, atlas fallback, x64 model worker/live DLL, exclusive Web native-cursor ownership with DOM cursor de-duplication, and all inherited performance/download/GameCube/streaming/Sony HID/Game Bar/provider/installer/ownership/freeze gates succeed together.
